description: A Dockerfile with a build stage on the `sdk` image and a final stage that copies only the published output into a runtime image.
The Microsoft image with the ASP.NET Core and .NET runtimes, used as the base of a web API's final stage.
A distroless Ubuntu variant (`10.0-noble-chiseled`) with only the packages .NET needs, a non-root user by default, and no shell or package manager.
The environment variable the .NET 8+ images set to `8080`, so Kestrel listens on an unprivileged port and the app can run as the `app` user.
`dotnet publish /t:PublishContainer` builds an OCI image from MSBuild properties such as `ContainerRepository` and `ContainerFamily`, with no Dockerfile.
An MSBuild property appended to the inferred base image tag, for example `noble-chiseled` or `alpine`.
A Compose setting that waits for a dependency's health check to pass before starting the dependent service.
